item.title: I broke AppLovin's mediation cipher protocol
item.description:
📝 The salt is a 32-byte constant baked into every AppLovin SDK binary, 21 meaningful bytes followed by 11 zero bytes. The cipher counter is System. Effectively every system property iOS exposes to third-party code.
🔗 Read more: https://www.buchodi.com/i-broke-applovins-mediation-cipher-protocol/

item.title: 'No way to prevent this,' says only package manager where this regularly happens
item.description:
📝 SAN FRANCISCO, CA - In the wake of a devastating supply chain attack in the npm registry that left millions of enterprise applications compromised and billions of user records exposed, developers across the JavaScript ecosystem expressed deep sorrow today, lamenting that such a crisis was completely unavoidable. js ecosystem stood unified in their belief that the malicious remote-code execution was a completely unpredictable tragedy, offering their thoughts and prayers to the DevOps teams currently scrambling to rotate their corporate AWS keys. “It’s devastating, but we have to accept that we live in a world where bad actors exist.
🔗 Read more: https://kevinpatel.xyz/posts/no-way-to-prevent-this/

item.title: Spectre Programming Language
item.description:
📝 Spectre Spectre is a programming language meant for safe and contract based low-level systems programming. This documentation aims to act as a user guide for the Spectre programming language. There is a notable lack of contract based programming languages that enforce correctness at a low level.
🔗 Read more: https://spectre-docs.pages.dev
